mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER_SOCIAL_ACCOUNT ( SOCIAL_ACCOUNT_ID, MEMBER_ID, PROVIDER, PROVIDER_USER_ID, PROVIDER_EMAIL, LINKED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_MEMBER_SOCIAL_ACCOUNT.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{provider}, #{providerUserId}, #{providerEmail, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT SOCIAL_ACCOUNT_ID, PROVIDER, PROVIDER_EMAIL, LINKED_AT, LAST_LOGIN_AT FROM MEMBER_SOCIAL_ACCOUNT WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY LINKED_AT
